latest_release.name: Add the secret type to env:add, and keep env validations in step on configure
latest_release.body:
## [7.7.0](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/compare/v7.6.0...v7.7.0) (2026-11-19)

### Features

- `env:add` accepts the `secret` type, from the prompt or with `--type=secret`. `node ace env:add API_KEY my_secret --type=secret` writes `API_KEY: Env.schema.secret()` to `start/env.ts`, and leaves the value out of `.env.example`. ([#5157](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/pull/5157))
- `node ace configure <package>` logs a warning for each env validation in `start/env.ts` that it keeps. Before, it kept them with no message, so a validation could disagree with the new package config. ([ed6bb1f](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/commit/ed6bb1fa3f2a5f25c4c99e459149d9383d9bb991))

### Bug fixes

- `node ace configure <package> --force` replaces the env validations of the package in `start/env.ts`. Before, it kept them, so for example `--store=redis` for `@adonisjs/session` left `SESSION_DRIVER` without `redis` and the app failed to type-check. ([4a83aee](https://github.com/adonisjs/core/commit/4a83aee1d84b1de59ec127db30a280ddb88cb851))

## What's Changed

- feat: add secret type to env:add command by @batosai in https://github.com/adonisjs/core/pull/5157

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adonisjs/core/compare/v7.6.0...v7.7.0
